[[File:Voodoodoll.png|thumb|A Sayormi voodoo doll]]
'''Voodoo''' was a ritual practice of the [[Sayormi]] in the [[Dead Forest (Kashyyyk)|Dead Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], used to curse their enemies, including the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of the [[Kerritamba Village]]. These rituals involved the use of voodoo dolls.<ref name= "RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> Voodoo was also used by the [[Witches of Dathomir]], a cult of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] witches from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and used by [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] to torture [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] into stopping the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|invasion]].<ref name= "Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>
